findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_step, get_play, search_plays, define_term, get_directory · Private data: search_knowledge · Public sink: join_waitlist, search_plays, get_directory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_step, get_play, search_plays, define_term, get_directory · Private data: search_knowledge · Public sink: join_waitlist, search_plays, get_directory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_knowledge" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
